name: Time Technoplast Ltd
tagline: Weak 5-year trailing average now clearly behind it: ~5 quarters of 20%+ PAT growth, composite (VAP) revenue +29% and rising toward 35% of mix, Rs 409 Cr of FY26 debt repaid with net-debt-free targeted in 12-18 months, ROCE improving 18.9% -> 23% by FY28 - all at a non-demanding ~19x P/E
business_overview: Time Technoplast is a polymer and composite products manufacturer - the world's largest maker of large plastic drums and third-largest in intermediate bulk containers (IBCs), alongside CNG/LPG composite cylinders, PE pipes, and emerging hydrogen-storage (Type-IV) cylinders. It is shifting its mix toward higher-margin 'value-added products' (VAP: composite cylinders, IBCs) away from legacy commodity packaging.
fundamentals_table: 4.46% trailing (weak) - but the recent-year inflection is now ~5 quarters deep
Revenue Rs 1,694 Cr (+25% YoY), EBITDA Rs 225 Cr (+15%), PAT Rs 116 Cr (+22% YoY); volume +11%; composite revenue +29.3%
Net debt cut Rs 409 Cr in FY26 (D/E ~0.25); net-debt-free targeted in 12-18 months
>15% volume growth: packaging 11-13%, composite 25-30%, PE pipes 22-25%
fundamentals_narrative: The 5-year trailing average (4.46% revenue CAGR) looks weak in isolation, but the inflection is now roughly five quarters deep: Q3 FY26 PAT ~+25% YoY, Q4 FY26 ~+20%, Q1 FY27 +22% on 25% revenue growth, with value-added products (composite cylinders, IBCs) consistently outgrowing legacy packaging (composite +29.3% in Q1 FY27). FY26 capex was Rs 370 Cr (Rs 172 Cr into VAP lines) achieved while simultaneously repaying Rs 409 Cr of net debt; management targets net-debt-free within 12-18 months, which removes interest as a drag on PAT. ROCE was 18.9% in FY26 with a 20% near-term target and a 23%+ FY28 guide as the VAP mix rises from ~27% (FY25) toward ~35%. The Type-IV composite / hydrogen cylinder order book is ~Rs 165 Cr, with expansion gated by PESO approvals and international disruptions. At ~18.8x trailing P/E for ~20% PAT growth plus a deleveraging tailwind, the valuation is undemanding.
technical_read: Not independently pulled this pass; 52-week range Rs 154-249, in the middle of the range after some cooling from the QIP-driven highs.
sentiment_summary: Long-running thread with a clear shift in tone starting mid-2025: multiple quarterly result summaries (mostly from ranvir) show consistent margin and PAT growth acceleration. A standout post (r8b8, 51 loves) argues 2027 could be a 'hockey stick' inflection driven by India's reliance on 'virtual pipeline' hydrogen delivery via Time's PESO-approved Type-IV composite cylinders - the company is described as the first and only Indian company with final PESO approval for hydrogen composite cylinders. Pass-1 deep dive corroborated the acceleration via Q1 FY27 results and the Aug-2026 concall.
community_signal: ranvir (trusted user) has posted every quarterly result for over a year, consistently highlighting accelerating VAP growth and debt reduction; a separate community member (pranavpallod12) projects 20-25% PAT CAGR over the medium term from CNG cascade capacity, LPG 14.2kg cylinder breakthrough potential, FIBC acquisition, and hydrogen optionality.

trusted_signals.note: "Have increased portfolio weights behind bets where I think that growth rates can be faster + valuations r not expensive" - listed alongside MAN Industries and Entero Healthcare (post #1874). A moderate-conviction addition-to-weight call, not an explicit top-holding statement. Source of this stock's trusted-thread queueing.

bse_notes: No red-flag corporate actions found. Promoter group made a small (0.02%) open-market purchase in Nov 2025 alongside the QIP, a mildly positive signal.
bull_case: Inflection is now ~5 quarters deep (Q3 FY26 +25%, Q4 FY26 +20%, Q1 FY27 +22% PAT YoY) - a genuine multi-quarter trend, not a single-quarter pop
VAP / composite products growing 25-30% and rising toward 35% of mix - a structural, higher-margin, higher-ROCE shift with CNG cascades, PE pipes and hydrogen optionality behind it
FY26 debt cut Rs 409 Cr; net-debt-free targeted in 12-18 months - removes the interest drag and lifts ROCE (18.9% -> 20% -> 23%+ FY28 guide)
First-mover PESO approval for Type-IV hydrogen composite cylinders (Rs 165 Cr order book) positions it for the 'virtual pipeline' hydrogen-economy opportunity
Valuation undemanding at ~18.8x trailing P/E for ~20% PAT growth plus deleveraging
bear_case: 5-year trailing revenue CAGR of 4.46% is genuinely weak - the inflection, though multi-quarter, is only ~1.5 years deep

One long-time holder (Aditya_Kapoor) notes management has 'guided' toward the 14.2kg LPG composite cylinder breakthrough for 4 years without full delivery - a pattern of promised-but-delayed catalysts (guidance_credibility mixed)
Q1 FY27 EBITDA grew only 15% versus revenue +25% - polymer/crude-linked cost pressure compressed the incremental margin
Hydrogen / Type-IV expansion is gated by PESO approvals and international disruptions - timeline not in management's control
Legacy commodity packaging is still the majority of the mix; TAM to support a 10x off a ~Rs 9,200 Cr cap is a stretch
Iran-War-type geopolitical exposure on the export side (overseas ~30-40% of revenue)
verdict_headline: A real, ~5-quarter margin/growth inflection funded by debt-cutting, with a structural VAP mix shift and improving ROCE at a cheap multiple - four-box score 3.0, conviction raised to Medium-High
verdict_reasoning: Per this project's recent-quarter-inflection rule, a weak 3-5yr trailing average does not disqualify when there is a strong, specific, sustained recent improvement - here ~5 consecutive quarters of ~20-25% PAT growth alongside genuine, debt-funded balance-sheet repair

The VAP / composite shift (25-30% growth, mix 27% -> 35%, PESO hydrogen approval) is a structural tailwind, and the FY26 -> FY28 ROCE path (18.9% -> 23%+) plus net-debt-free target compound the earnings quality
four_box score 3.0 (tailwind yes / tam weak / moat weak / valuation yes) -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted; valuation box is yes at ~18.8x P/E for ~20% growth

Conviction Medium -> Medium-High: multi-quarter consistency, deleveraging execution, improving ROCE and an undemanding multiple, tempered by the 4-year-delayed LPG catalyst, commodity-legacy majority and Q1 margin lag. No red flag; no trusted-conviction floor active. Flagged for 30-day revisit
